correctness.rationale: The two divisor-partition lemmas are proved explicitly. Each certified residue class yields a positive representation with a CRT square witness bounded by 15376; the 70-event forces valuation one at 2,5,7. For odd \(p\), \(|G_p|=(p-1)(p+2)/2\) is derived by complete root-lift cases. CRT factorization of the four binary square strata gives the exact previous ten-prime density. The additional event has density (1/2)(14/25)(27/49), disjoint from all p>=5 events and independent of \(p=3\), so its exclusive density is (1/2)(14/25)(27/49)(4/9)=12/175. Independent exact computations of all relevant local counts and rational sums match the proof; finite checks are corroboration, not infinite proof.

value.rationale: The claim makes a quantitatively substantial improvement (+12/175, 6.857 percentage points) toward the explicitly stated 2023 square-summand density-one conjecture. The value derives from identifying mixed-prime 70 support that reaches binary nonsquare residue classes missed by the ten-prime singleton-support sieve, not from an arbitrary finite enumeration. The fraction is a natural rigorous lower-density invariant of the additive problem, with constructive CRT representations.
